newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish GDP grows 7.3 pct yr/yr in Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Polish GDP grows 7.3 pct yr/yr in Q1 1997.

text.p: Poland's gross domestic product (GDP) grew by 7.3 percent in the first quarter of 1997 against the same period of last year, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said on Friday.
GUS said in a statement the rise was mainly a result of strong growth in gross added value in the industrial and construction sectors.

"The growth was mainly a result of a high pace of growth in added gross value in the industry which reached 7.6 percent and a 19.5 percent growth in the construction sector against the weak first quarter of last year," GUS said.
GUS said services grew in the first quarter by 6.6 percent.
GUS earlier estimated GDP growth in the whole of 1996 at six percent.
